caption: The drawing depicts a single, realistic wooden hand, shown palm facing forward with the fingers slightly separated. The object is predominantly brown with various shades used to create the appearance of wood grain and shadows for a three-dimensional effect. The wrist is topped with a cylindrical, stump-like ending, and a small metal hook curves upward from the center of the top, suggesting that the wooden hand could be hung or displayed. The background is plain and light-colored, offering no additional objects or scenery. The composition centers the wooden hand prominently within the frame.
title: Glove Shop Sign
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
